name: Senegal

fees.name: Senegal biometric e-Visa (pre-enrolment via visasenegal.sn)
fees.applies: nationalities not visa-exempt and without a reciprocity waiver
fees.notes: Official Senegal e-visa/pre-enrolment portal. Base fee of EUR 50 plus a card-processing fee of EUR 2.50-5.00 depending on payment method, non-refundable if refused. WebFetch of visasenegal.sn returned only header content (JS-rendered site); amount corroborated via secondary aggregator sources citing the official portal, not independently confirmed on-page by this session. Senegal announced in 2025 a move to a broader reciprocity-based e-visa policy; exact country-by-country fee schedule under that new system was not found on an official source as of this record's date.

fees.name: Consular sticker visa (embassy/consulate-issued)
fees.notes: Senegal consulate (Paris) visa application page lists required documents for visa categories A/B/C but does not publish fee amounts on-page; page directs applicants to contact infovisa-paris@diplomatie.gouv.sn for current fees. Not verified numerically from an official source.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No official fee schedule found for a distinct transit visa category.

fees.name: Business visa
fees.notes: Business visa follows the same e-visa/consular sticker process as tourist visa; no distinct official fee found beyond the general EUR 50 e-visa base fee.

reciprocity_variations.note: Official U.S. State Department reciprocity schedule states Senegal charges NO visa issuance fee ('None') to U.S. citizens across all nonimmigrant visa categories (tourist, business, student, work, etc.), though standard e-visa/administrative enrolment steps may still apply. Source: travel.state.gov Senegal reciprocity page.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates a centre in Dakar, Senegal, but it processes OUTBOUND visa applications by residents of Senegal applying to other countries (France, UK, Netherlands, South Africa, Canada, etc.), not inbound applications for a Senegal visa. No evidence found that Senegal itself outsources its own visa issuance to VFS Global, TLScontact, or BLS International; Senegal's own inbound process runs through the official visasenegal.sn e-visa portal and consulates/embassies directly.

free_visa_notes: Senegal is not visa-free for all nationalities; many nationalities require the online e-visa/pre-enrolment (visasenegal.sn) plus consular issuance, though a number of nationalities benefit from visa exemptions or reciprocity waivers (e.g., U.S. citizens pay no fee per State Department reciprocity data). A 2025 government announcement indicated a broader reciprocity-based e-visa policy was being rolled out; a detailed, current official fee table by nationality was not locatable on an official Senegalese government source as of 2026-07-02.
